script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.command,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       j.picking_id,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS started_at,
       (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_PCguard.data.jobId}}

SELECT CAST(st.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       st.step_name,
       st.step_status
  FROM gd_publish_step st
 WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.jobId}}'
   AND st.is_deleted = 0

SELECT j.prepared_payload
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_PCguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT (SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR)
          FROM su_code_serial_no_rule r
         WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND r.business_type = 'Packing'
           AND r.department_id = {{node:code_node_PCentry.data.organizationId}}
           AND r.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY r.is_draft, r.is_default DESC, r.id
         LIMIT 1) AS rule_id,
       (SELECT k.packing_mode
          FROM packing_setup k
         WHERE k.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND k.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PCentry.data.organizationId}}'
           AND k.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY k.id
         LIMIT 1) AS packing_mode
